parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name.

Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If you do not specify a value for this parameter, all accelerated domain names are queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for a query. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see **Usage notes**.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP).

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query ISPs.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query regions.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-qps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Interval 300
